notes.phdFundingExpectation: For Chinese PhD students, the in-app practical funding note follows current-student feedback supplied by the seller: KU scholarship and KU-CSC are presented as two common paths, with KU scholarship cash-flow estimates shown separately from official award language.
notes.cscAmount: KU-CSC details are shown as offer-dependent because the public KU catalog and CSC-side award terms may not provide one fixed public amount for every student.
notes.wqe: Writing Qualifying Exam pass-rate, scholarship pause rules, GPA pause thresholds, and Q1 graduation note are marked in-app as non-official current-student feedback supplied by the seller.
